link.title: Getting Started with Full-Stack Development
link.description: Welcome to CodeHarborHub! Before we dive into code, let's set up your environment, adopt the right mindset, and understand the core fundamentals of the web. This section will guide you through the essential tools, technologies, and concepts you need to kickstart your journey into full-stack development. Whether you're a complete beginner or just looking to solidify your foundation, this roadmap will ensure you're well-prepared to tackle the exciting world of web development.
